<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AMI Integração — Cadastro de Membros</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Caveat:wght@600;700&family=Sora:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ami-logo:url("data:image/png;base64,")}
/* ═══════════════ AMI INTEGRAÇÃO ═══════════════ */
:root{
  --red:#C9151F; --red-hot:#F0323D; --red-deep:#5E080D; --red-glow:rgba(201,21,31,.28);
  --bg:#050506; --surface:#0D0D0F; --surface-2:#131315; --overlay:#1B1B1E;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.07); --line-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.13);
  --ink:#F2F0F0; --muted:#A9A3A4; --faint:#7A7476;
  --amber:#FFB020; --blue:#3D8BFD; --green:#2ECC71; --magenta:#F04BD8;
  --cyan:#2BD9E8; --violet:#9B6BFF; --orange:#FF7A1A;
  --success:#2ECC71; --warning:#FFB020; --danger:#FF3B52; --info:#3D8BFD;
  --pacheco:#FF3B52; --amendoeira:#FFB020;
  --radius:14px; --radius-sm:9px;
  --shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  --font-ui:'Sora',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-display:'Anton',Impact,sans-serif;
  --font-script:'Caveat',cursive;
  --topbar-h:64px; --sidebar-w:236px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:var(--font-ui); background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink);
  min-height:100vh; overflow-x:hidden; font-size:15px; line-height:1.5;
}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;color:inherit}
input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
svg{fill:currentColor;width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}
[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* scrollbars na linguagem do app */
*{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--red-deep) var(--surface)}
*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px}
*::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--surface)}
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--red),var(--red-deep));border-radius:6px;border:2px solid var(--surface)}
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--red-hot)}

::selection{background:var(--red);color:#fff}

/* fundo do sistema com a marca AMI */
.system-bg{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 50% 0%, rgba(201,21,31,.05), transparent 70%),
    #050506;
}
.system-mark{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:var(--ami-logo) center 34%/min(62vh,600px) no-repeat;
  opacity:.08;
}

.brand-script{font-family:var(--font-script);font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:.9}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;flex:none}
.dot-pacheco{background:var(--pacheco);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--pacheco)}
.dot-amendoeira{background:var(--amendoeira);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--amendoeira)}

/* ═══════════ LOGIN ═══════════ */
.login-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto;z-index:50}
.login-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 45% at 50% 6%, rgba(201,21,31,.08), transparent 72%),
    #050506;
  animation:bgBreath 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes bgBreath{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.login-veil{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 18%, transparent 20%, rgba(3,3,4,.6) 75%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3,3,4,.3) 0%, rgba(3,3,4,.75) 55%, rgba(3,3,4,.95) 100%);
}
.login-mark{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:var(--ami-logo) center 44%/min(76vh,700px) no-repeat;
  opacity:.1;
}
.login-embers{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.ember{
  position:absolute;bottom:-12px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,#FFD9A0 0%,var(--red-hot) 45%,transparent 70%);
  animation:emberUp linear infinite;opacity:0;
}
@keyframes emberUp{
  0%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0);opacity:0}
  8%{opacity:.6}
  60%{opacity:.32}
  100%{transform:translateY(-105vh) translateX(var(--sway,40px));opacity:0}
}
.login-content{
  position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:clamp(10px,2vh,16px) 20px;
  width:min(560px,100%);margin:auto;
}
.rise{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);animation:rise .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
@keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.login-brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;text-shadow:0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.login-logo{
  display:block;height:clamp(96px,20vh,192px);width:auto;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(201,21,31,.16));
}
.login-brand .brand-script{font-size:clamp(34px,min(9vw,7vh),56px)}
.brand-tag{font-size:15px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.02em}
.brand-tag b{font-weight:800}
.login-title{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(30px,min(8.5vw,8vh),64px);letter-spacing:.04em;
  margin-top:clamp(2px,.8vh,10px);color:#fff;
  text-shadow:0 0 26px var(--red-glow),0 4px 0 #3A0509,0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.85);
}
.login-sub{font-family:var(--font-script);font-size:clamp(18px,min(4vw,3.6vh),32px);color:#E8DCDC;margin-top:2px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
.login-card{
  position:relative;margin:clamp(8px,2.2vh,26px) auto 0;padding:clamp(14px,2.2vh,26px) clamp(18px,4vw,30px) clamp(12px,1.8vh,22px);text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(18,18,20,.92),rgba(7,7,8,.95));
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:20px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;
}
.login-card-glow{position:absolute;top:-70px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:320px;height:140px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,var(--red-glow),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.login-card h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;position:relative}
.login-units{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:clamp(6px,1.2vh,14px) 0 4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.unit-pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.login-hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(12px,1.9vh,13.5px);margin:clamp(6px,1.2vh,12px) 0 clamp(8px,1.6vh,20px)}
.login-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(7px,1.3vh,12px);text-align:left;margin:0 auto;max-width:320px}
.login-form label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.login-form input{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;
  padding:clamp(8px,1.4vh,11px) 13px;color:var(--ink);font-size:clamp(13px,2vh,14px);font-family:inherit;font-weight:500;
  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;
}
.login-form input::placeholder{color:var(--faint);font-weight:400}
.login-form input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--red-hot);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red-glow)}
.login-submit{width:100%;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(9px,1.5vh,12px) 20px;font-size:clamp(13px,2vh,14.5px);margin-top:4px}
.login-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:clamp(7px,1.3vh,14px)}
.login-foot{margin-top:clamp(8px,1.8vh,22px);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
@media (max-height:720px){
  .login-sub{display:none}
}
@media (max-height:620px){
  .login-hint{display:none}
}
@media (max-height:560px){
  .login-note,.login-foot{display:none}
  .login-units{margin-top:2px}
}

@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes popIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92) translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ═══════════ ESTRUTURA DO APP ═══════════ */
.app{display:flex;min-height:100vh;animation:fadeIn .4s;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sidebar{
  width:var(--sidebar-w);flex:none;position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;z-index:40;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0D0D0F 0%,#070708 100%);
  border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:22px 16px 16px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
}
.side-brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.side-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:20%;right:20%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--red),transparent)}
.side-brand-img{
  display:block;width:min(168px,100%);height:auto;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(201,21,31,.13));
}
.topbar-brand{
  display:none;height:40px;width:auto;flex:none;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 10px rgba(201,21,31,.24));
}
.side-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;margin-top:20px}
.side-link{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);transition:all .18s;position:relative;text-align:left;
}
.side-link svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.side-link:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.side-link.active{
  color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(201,21,31,.18),rgba(201,21,31,.05));
  box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--red);
}
.side-link.active svg{color:var(--red-hot);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--red-glow))}
.nav-count{
  margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:var(--red-deep);
  color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;min-width:26px;text-align:center;
}
.side-verse{margin-top:auto;padding:16px 8px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.side-verse p{font-family:var(--font-script);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.35;color:#D9CBCB}
.side-verse-ref{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--red-hot);font-weight:600}
.side-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 8px 2px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.side-user-info{min-width:0;flex:1}
.side-user-info b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.side-user-info span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.avatar{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.02em;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--av-a,#C9151F),var(--av-b,#4E070C));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
}
.avatar-sm{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:13px}
.avatar-lg{width:76px;height:76px;font-size:27px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

.icon-btn{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--muted);transition:all .15s;font-size:14px;flex:none;
}
.icon-btn:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.icon-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}

.main-col{flex:1;margin-left:var(--sidebar-w);min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.topbar{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;height:var(--topbar-h);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:0 26px;
  background:rgba(8,8,9,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.unit-switch{display:flex;gap:4px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:4px}
.unit-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--muted);transition:all .18s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.unit-btn:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.unit-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red),var(--red-deep));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px var(--red-glow)}
.unit-btn.active .dot{background:#fff;box-shadow:none}
.topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;
  padding:10px 18px;border-radius:10px;transition:all .18s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.btn-primary{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red) 0%,var(--red-deep) 100%);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px var(--red-glow);
}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px var(--red-glow);filter:brightness(1.1)}
.btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.btn-danger{background:rgba(255,59,82,.14);color:var(--danger);border:1px solid rgba(255,59,82,.3)}
.btn-danger:hover{background:rgba(255,59,82,.24)}
.btn-sm{padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:8px}

.main{padding:26px;flex:1;min-width:0}

/* versículo do dia */
.verse-label{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red-hot);margin-bottom:8px}
.verse-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:14px 26px 0;padding:12px 18px;
  border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--red);
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(201,21,31,.07),rgba(155,107,255,.04) 55%,rgba(43,217,232,.03));
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.verse-bar::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 120% at 0% 50%,rgba(201,21,31,.09),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.verse-ico{width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--red-hot);flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--red-glow));position:relative}
.verse-bar-body{flex:1;min-width:0;position:relative}
.verse-bar-label{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red-hot);margin-bottom:2px}
.verse-bar-text{font-family:var(--font-script);font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#F3DCDC}
.verse-bar-ref{flex:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--amber);letter-spacing:.04em;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,176,32,.35);border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,176,32,.1);white-space:nowrap;position:relative}
.verse-swap{animation:verseSwap .6s ease}
@keyframes verseSwap{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.view{animation:viewIn .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes viewIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.view-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.view-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1.1}
.view-title small{display:block;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.view-title .hl{color:var(--red-hot)}

/* ═══════════ PAINEL ═══════════ */
.hero{
  position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:22px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);min-height:170px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;
  background-color:#060607;
}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(4,4,5,.97) 30%,rgba(4,4,5,.7) 62%,rgba(201,21,31,.06))}
.hero::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:var(--ami-logo) right clamp(14px,2.4vw,34px) center/clamp(112px,20vh,178px) auto no-repeat;
  opacity:.94;
}
.hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:26px clamp(150px,22vh,205px) 26px 28px;width:100%}
.hero-hello{font-family:var(--font-script);font-size:30px;color:#F0E4E4;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}
.hero-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,40px);letter-spacing:.05em;text-shadow:0 0 24px var(--red-glow),0 3px 0 #3A0509}
.hero-sub{font-size:13px;color:#DCCACA;margin-top:4px}
.hero-sub b{color:var(--amber)}

.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.stat{
  position:relative;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--surface-2),var(--surface));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:18px 18px 15px;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;
}
.stat:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.stat::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--sc,var(--red))}
.stat::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-30px;right:-30px;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--sc,var(--red)) 0%,transparent 70%);opacity:.14}
.stat-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.stat-label svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--sc,var(--red))}
.stat-value{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:40px;line-height:1.15;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.stat-foot{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.stat-foot b{color:var(--sc,var(--red))}

.dash-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.panel{
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--surface-2),var(--surface));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:20px;min-width:0;
}
.panel-title{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:16px}
.panel-title svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--red-hot)}
.panel-title .panel-link{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--red-hot);transition:color .15s}
.panel-title .panel-link:hover{color:#fff}

.min-bar-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:118px 1fr 34px;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:11px}
.min-bar-label{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.min-bar-track{height:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.min-bar-fill{
  height:100%;border-radius:99px;width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mc),color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 55%,#fff 8%));
  box-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 55%,transparent);
  transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
.min-bar-num{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:right;color:var(--ink)}

.mini-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.mini-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 6px;border-radius:10px;
  transition:background .15s;cursor:pointer;
}
.mini-row:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.mini-row + .mini-row{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.mini-info{min-width:0;flex:1}
.mini-info b{display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;min-width:0}
.mi-name{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}
.mini-info span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.mini-side{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-align:right;flex:none}
.mini-side .bday-today{color:var(--amber)}
.empty-note{color:var(--faint);font-size:13px;padding:14px 4px;text-align:center}

.unit-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:16px}
.unit-card{
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.unit-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--uc)}
.unit-card b{font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.unit-card .unit-num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;margin-top:2px;color:var(--uc)}
.unit-card span{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}

/* ═══════════ MEMBROS ═══════════ */
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.search-box{
  position:relative;flex:1;min-width:200px;max-width:360px;
}
.search-box svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--faint);pointer-events:none}
.search-box input{
  width:100%;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px 34px 10px 36px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;
}
.search-box input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,21,31,.13)}
.search-clear{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.search-clear:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.search-box.has-value .search-clear{display:flex}

.select-wrap{position:relative}
.select-wrap select{
  appearance:none;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px 32px 10px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s;
}
.select-wrap select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--red)}
.select-wrap::after{
  content:'▾';position:absolute;right:11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--faint);font-size:11px;pointer-events:none;
}
.toolbar-spacer{flex:1}
.savedviews-wrap{position:relative}
.savedviews-menu{
  position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;z-index:60;min-width:250px;
  background:var(--overlay);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:8px;animation:popIn .2s;
}
.savedviews-menu .sv-empty{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--faint);padding:10px;text-align:center}
.sv-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 6px 4px 10px}
.sv-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.sv-apply{flex:1;text-align:left;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:6px 0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sv-meta{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:400}
.sv-del{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px;flex:none}
.sv-del:hover{color:var(--danger);background:rgba(255,59,82,.12)}
.sv-save-current{
  width:100%;margin-top:6px;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--red-hot);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;
}
.sv-save-current:hover{background:rgba(201,21,31,.07)}

.bulkbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(201,21,31,.16),rgba(201,21,31,.06));
  border:1px solid rgba(201,21,31,.24);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;
  animation:viewIn .25s;
}
.bulkbar b{font-size:13.5px}
.bulkbar .select-wrap select{padding:7px 30px 7px 11px;font-size:12.5px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.bulkbar .bulk-clear{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600}
.bulkbar .bulk-clear:hover{color:#fff}

.result-meta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:10px}
.result-meta b{color:var(--muted)}

.member-table{
  width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--surface-2),var(--surface));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;
}
.member-table th{
  text-align:left;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--faint);padding:13px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.member-table td{padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13.5px;vertical-align:middle}
.member-table tbody tr{cursor:pointer;transition:background .13s}
.member-table tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(201,21,31,.06)}
.member-table tbody tr.selected{background:rgba(201,21,31,.1)}
.member-table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:var(--radius)}
.cell-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:190px}
.cell-name b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.cell-name span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.cell-phone{white-space:nowrap;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}

.badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.badge::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.badge-ativo{background:rgba(46,204,113,.13);color:var(--success)}
.badge-integracao{background:rgba(255,176,32,.13);color:var(--warning)}
.badge-visitante{background:rgba(61,139,253,.13);color:var(--info)}
.badge-unit{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.badge-unit::before{display:none}
.badge-pacheco{background:rgba(255,59,82,.12);color:var(--pacheco)}
.badge-amendoeira{background:rgba(255,176,32,.12);color:var(--amendoeira)}
.chip-min{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;
  border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc,#8F7376) 14%,transparent);
  color:var(--mc,#C4A6A6);white-space:nowrap;
}
.row-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:flex-end}
.row-actions .icon-btn{width:30px;height:30px}
.row-actions .icon-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.row-actions .del:hover{color:var(--danger);background:rgba(255,59,82,.12)}

input[type="checkbox"].rowcheck{
  appearance:none;width:17px;height:17px;border:1.5px solid var(--faint);border-radius:5px;
  cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:all .15s;vertical-align:middle;background:transparent;
}
input[type="checkbox"].rowcheck:hover{border-color:var(--red-hot)}
input[type="checkbox"].rowcheck:checked{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
input[type="checkbox"].rowcheck:checked::after{
  content:'✓';position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;
}

.empty-state{
  text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
}
.empty-state .empty-heart{font-size:0;margin-bottom:14px}
.empty-state .empty-heart svg{width:52px;height:52px;color:var(--red-deep)}
.empty-state h3{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:6px}
.empty-state p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:18px}

/* ═══════════ ANIVERSARIANTES ═══════════ */
.month-strip{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.month-btn{
  padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:all .15s;
}
.month-btn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.month-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red),var(--red-deep));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 3px 12px var(--red-glow)}
.month-btn .mb-count{opacity:.65;font-weight:400;margin-left:4px}
.bday-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:14px}
.bday-card{
  display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--surface-2),var(--surface));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.bday-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.bday-card.today{border-color:rgba(255,176,32,.5);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,176,32,.1),var(--surface))}
.bday-card.today::after{
  content:'🎉 HOJE!';position:absolute;top:10px;right:-30px;transform:rotate(35deg);
  background:var(--amber);color:#231400;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 34px;letter-spacing:.08em;
}
.bday-day{
  flex:none;width:52px;text-align:center;background:rgba(201,21,31,.1);border:1px solid rgba(201,21,31,.24);
  border-radius:11px;padding:7px 0;
}
.bday-card.today .bday-day{background:rgba(255,176,32,.16);border-color:rgba(255,176,32,.4)}
.bday-day b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;color:var(--red-hot);line-height:1}
.bday-card.today .bday-day b{color:var(--amber)}
.bday-day span{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.bday-info{min-width:0;flex:1}
.bday-info b{display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px;min-width:0}
.bday-info span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);display:block}
.bday-age{flex:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding:5px 9px;border-radius:99px}

/* ═══════════ DRAWER ═══════════ */
.drawer-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(5,2,3,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);animation:fadeIn .25s}
.drawer{
  position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:95;width:min(430px,100vw);
  background:linear-gradient(200deg,#241318,#150A0E);border-left:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:-20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
  animation:drawerIn .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
@keyframes drawerIn{from{transform:translateX(60px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.drawer-hero{
  position:relative;padding:26px 24px 20px;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(201,21,31,.16),transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.drawer-hero .avatar-lg{margin:8px auto 12px}
.drawer-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px}
.drawer-name{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25}
.drawer-badges{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.drawer-body{padding:20px 24px 26px}
.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.detail-item{min-width:0}
.detail-item.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.detail-item dt{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:3px}
.detail-item dd{font-size:13.5px;word-break:break-word}
.detail-item dd a{color:var(--red-hot);text-decoration:none}
.detail-item dd a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.detail-notes{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px;white-space:pre-wrap;
}
.drawer-actions{display:flex;gap:10px}
.drawer-actions .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}
.baptized-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600}

/* ═══════════ MODAL FORM ═══════════ */
.modal-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110;background:rgba(5,2,3,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;animation:fadeIn .2s;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
}
.modal{
  width:min(640px,100%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#251419,#170B0F);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  animation:popIn .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.15);max-height:calc(100vh - 36px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 36px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.modal-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 24px 16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:none;
}
.modal-head h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.member-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
.form-scroll{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px 16px;padding:22px 24px}
.form-grid label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);min-width:0}
.form-grid .span-2{grid-column:1/-1}
.form-grid input:not([type="checkbox"]),.form-grid select,.form-grid textarea{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:9px;
  padding:10px 12px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;width:100%;
}
.form-grid select{appearance:none;cursor:pointer}
.form-grid textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:64px}
.form-grid input:focus,.form-grid select:focus,.form-grid textarea:focus{
  outline:none;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,21,31,.13);
}
.form-grid input.invalid{border-color:var(--danger)}
.form-grid input[type="date"]{color-scheme:dark}
.field-err{font-size:11px;color:var(--danger);font-style:normal;font-weight:500;display:none}
.field-err.show{display:block}
.check-label{flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center;gap:10px!important;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px!important;color:var(--ink)!important;align-self:end;padding-bottom:10px}
.check-label input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0}
.check-box{
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;border:1.5px solid var(--faint);flex:none;position:relative;transition:all .15s;
}
.check-label input:checked + .check-box{background:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.check-label input:checked + .check-box::after{content:'✓';position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#04262A;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.check-label input:focus-visible + .check-box{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(43,217,232,.3)}
.modal-foot{
  display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:16px 24px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#170B0F;flex:none;
}
body.modal-open{overflow:hidden}

/* ═══════════ POPOVER SALVAR VISÃO ═══════════ */
.saveview-pop{
  position:fixed;z-index:130;width:270px;background:var(--overlay);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:16px;animation:popIn .2s;
}
.saveview-pop label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:7px}
.saveview-pop input{
  width:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;
}
.saveview-pop input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--red)}
.saveview-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}

/* ═══════════ TOASTS ═══════════ */
.toasts{position:fixed;bottom:22px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:300;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:min(480px,calc(100vw - 32px))}
.toast{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2E171D,#1D0E12);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-left:4px solid var(--tc,var(--success));border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);animation:toastIn .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);
  font-size:13.5px;
}
.toast.out{animation:toastOut .25s forwards}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px) scale(.95)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes toastOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.96)}}
.toast svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--tc,var(--success))}
.toast span{flex:1}
.toast .toast-undo{
  font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--amber);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,176,32,.12);transition:background .15s;flex:none;
}
.toast .toast-undo:hover{background:rgba(255,176,32,.24)}
.toast .toast-x{color:var(--faint);font-size:12px;flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px}
.toast .toast-x:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

/* ═══════════ RESPONSIVO ═══════════ */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .dash-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  :root{--sidebar-w:0px}
  .sidebar{
    inset:auto 0 0 0;width:100%;height:62px;flex-direction:row;padding:0 8px;
    border-right:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);
    background:rgba(20,8,12,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);align-items:center;z-index:80;
  }
  .side-brand,.side-verse{display:none}
  .topbar-brand{display:block}
  .side-nav{flex-direction:row;margin:0;flex:1;justify-content:space-around;gap:0}
  .side-link{flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:10px;border-radius:10px}
  .side-link.active{box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--red)}
  .side-link svg{width:20px;height:20px}
  .nav-count{position:absolute;top:2px;right:4px;margin:0;font-size:9px;padding:1px 6px;min-width:18px}
  .side-user{border-top:none;padding:0 4px;flex:none}
  .side-user-info{display:none}
  .main-col{margin-left:0;padding-bottom:70px}
  .topbar{padding:0 14px;height:auto;min-height:var(--topbar-h);flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px;gap:8px}
  .unit-btn{padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}
  .main{padding:16px 14px}
  .verse-bar{margin:10px 14px 0;padding:10px 14px}
  .verse-bar-text{font-size:17px}
  .toasts{bottom:76px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
  .stat{padding:14px}
  .stat-value{font-size:30px}
  .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:18px}
  .detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .btn#btn-new-top span{display:none}
  .btn#btn-new-top{padding:10px 12px}
  .view-title{font-size:24px}
  .hero{background-size:92px auto;background-position:right 10px center}
  .hero::after{background-size:92px auto;background-position:right 10px center}
  .hero-inner{padding:18px 106px 18px 18px}
  .toolbar{gap:8px}
  .search-box{max-width:none;flex-basis:100%}
  .unit-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .member-table th:nth-child(4),.member-table td:nth-child(4),
  .member-table th:nth-child(5),.member-table td:nth-child(5){display:none}
  .login-card{padding:24px 18px 20px}
  .verse-bar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
  .verse-bar-ref{margin-left:40px}
}

/* ═══════════ PAPÉIS & ADMINISTRADORES ═══════════ */
.role-tag{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:1px 0}
.role-geral{color:var(--amber)}
.role-admin{color:var(--info)}
.role-user{color:var(--cyan)}
.lbl-short{display:none}
.login-error{
  margin:0 0 14px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;text-align:left;
  background:rgba(255,59,82,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,59,82,.4);
  color:#FFB4BE;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
}
.admin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.admin-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.admin-card{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);transition:border-color .18s,transform .18s;
}
.admin-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.admin-card.geral{
  border-color:rgba(255,176,32,.4);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,176,32,.1),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,176,32,.09);
}
.admin-info{flex:1;min-width:170px}
.admin-info b{font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.admin-info > span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);word-break:break-all}
.admin-meta{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:3px}
.you-tag{
  font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:rgba(46,204,113,.15);color:var(--success);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;
}
.badge-role{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.badge-role svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.badge-role.role-geral{background:rgba(255,176,32,.14)}
.badge-role.role-admin{background:rgba(61,139,253,.14)}
.badge-role.role-user{background:rgba(43,217,232,.12)}
.admin-card .icon-btn.del:hover{color:var(--danger);background:rgba(255,59,82,.12)}
.admin-card .icon-btn:hover{color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(43,217,232,.12)}
.admin-form-grid{padding:0!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:12px!important}
.admin-submit{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px}
.admin-cancel{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}
.admin-hint{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5}
.perm-row{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0}
.perm-row + .perm-row{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.perm-ico{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.perm-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.perm-ico.role-geral{background:rgba(255,176,32,.14)}
.perm-ico.role-admin{background:rgba(61,139,253,.14)}
.perm-ico.role-user{background:rgba(43,217,232,.12)}
.perm-row b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.perm-row div span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
@media (max-width:1100px){.admin-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .lbl-long{display:none}
  .lbl-short{display:inline}
}

/* ═══════════ Aviso de armazenamento local ═══════════ */
.storage-warn{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:120;
  max-width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 32px));display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;
  padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,176,32,.4);
  background:rgba(28,20,8,.96);color:#F3E3C6;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
}
.storage-warn svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--amber);flex:none;margin-top:1px}
.storage-warn b{color:#FFD79B}
.storage-warn button{margin-left:auto;color:#C9B79B;font-size:16px;line-height:1;flex:none}

/* ═══════════ Peniel e interesse em servir ═══════════ */
.flag-chip{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;
}
.flag-chip svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.flag-chip.peniel{color:#FFD79B;border-color:rgba(255,176,32,.4);background:rgba(255,176,32,.1)}
.flag-chip.servir{color:#9BE9C0;border-color:rgba(46,204,113,.36);background:rgba(46,204,113,.1)}
.mini-flags{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;margin-top:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mini-flags .flag-chip{font-size:9.5px;padding:2px 7px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.mini-flags .flag-chip svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.drawer-flags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 16px}
.agentes-cta{
  position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;
  padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(201,21,31,.3);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,21,31,.14),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  overflow:hidden;
}
.agentes-cta::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;right:-30px;bottom:-40px;width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,21,31,.22),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;
}
.agentes-cta b{font-size:13.5px;position:relative}
.agentes-cta p{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;position:relative}
.agentes-cta .btn{align-self:flex-start;position:relative}
.peniel-panel .stat-mini{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.peniel-num{
  flex:1;min-width:104px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
}
.peniel-num b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;line-height:1.1}
.peniel-num span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
.peniel-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.peniel-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.peniel-row:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.peniel-row .mini-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.peniel-row .mini-info b{display:block;font-size:12.5px}
.peniel-row .mini-info span{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.peniel-cta{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:12px}

/* ═══════════ Unidades liberadas por usuário ═══════════ */
.unit-access{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.unit-access .check-label{
  flex:1;min-width:132px;padding:8px 12px!important;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);align-self:stretch;
}
.unit-access .check-label input:checked + .check-box{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
.unit-access .check-label input:checked + .check-box::after{color:#fff}
.unit-access .check-label input:disabled + .check-box{opacity:.45}
.unit-access .check-label:has(input:disabled){opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.unit-hint{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--faint);font-style:normal}
.admin-units{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:5px}
.admin-units .flag-chip{font-size:9.5px;padding:2px 7px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:none}
.admin-units .flag-chip svg{width:11px;height:11px}

/* ═══════════ Contato via WhatsApp ═══════════ */
.wa-tools{
  display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;
  padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
}
.wa-tools .search-box{flex:1;min-width:220px}
.wa-msg{flex:1;min-width:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.wa-msg span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.wa-msg input{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:9px;
  padding:9px 12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);
}
.wa-msg input:focus{outline:none;border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(37,211,102,.14)}
.wa-templates{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
.wa-tpl{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:99px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);transition:all .15s;
}
.wa-tpl:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.5);background:rgba(37,211,102,.1)}
.wa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:12px}
.wa-card{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--surface-2),var(--surface));
  transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s;
}
.wa-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.35)}
.wa-card .wa-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.wa-card .wa-info b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.wa-card .wa-info span{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.wa-card .wa-info .wa-flags{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.wa-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25D366,#128C7E);color:#04231A;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;
  transition:all .18s;flex:none;
}
.wa-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.wa-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.wa-btn.no-number{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:var(--faint);cursor:not-allowed;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.wa-summary{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px}
.wa-summary b{color:var(--ink)}
.wa-empty{padding:30px 10px}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .wa-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .wa-tools{padding:12px}
}
.acc-units-label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
#acc-units{margin-top:2px}
#acc-units .check-label{padding-bottom:0!important;font-size:12px!important}
#acc-units .check-label .dot{width:7px;height:7px}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="system-bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="system-mark" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<!-- ══════════ LOGIN ══════════ -->
<section id="login-screen" class="login-screen">
  <div class="login-bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="login-veil" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="login-mark" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="login-embers" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <div class="login-content">
    <div class="login-brand rise" style="--d:.05s">
      <img class="login-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="AMI — Amor em Movimento Igreja">
    </div>
    <h1 class="login-title rise" style="--d:.15s">INTEGRAÇÃO</h1>
    <p class="login-sub rise" style="--d:.25s">Juntos por um servir ainda mais forte!</p>

    <div class="login-card rise" style="--d:.4s">
      <div class="login-card-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <h2>Cadastro de Membros</h2>
      <p class="login-units">
        <span class="unit-pill"><i class="dot dot-pacheco"></i>AMI Pacheco</span>
        <span class="unit-pill"><i class="dot dot-amendoeira"></i>AMI Amendoeira</span>
      </p>
      <p class="login-hint">Entre com o seu próprio e-mail e senha cadastrados pelo administrador.</p>
      <p id="login-error" class="login-error" hidden></p>
      <form id="login-form" class="login-form" novalidate>
        <label>E-mail
          <input id="login-email" type="email" autocomplete="username" placeholder="voce@email.com" required>
        </label>
        <label>Senha
          <input id="login-pass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Sua senha" required>
        </label>
        <label id="login-pass2-row" hidden>Confirme a senha
          <input id="login-pass2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Repita a senha">
        </label>
        <button id="btn-login" class="btn btn-primary login-submit" type="submit">
          <span>Entrar</span>
        </button>
      </form>
      <p id="login-note" class="login-note">Acesso restrito. Neste dispositivo você continua conectado até clicar em Sair.</p>
    </div>
    <p class="login-foot rise" style="--d:.55s">AMI Pacheco &nbsp•&nbsp; AMI Amendoeira — São Gonçalo, RJ</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════ APP ══════════ -->
<div id="app" class="app" hidden>
  <aside class="sidebar">
    <div class="side-brand">
      <img class="side-brand-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="AMI — Amor em Movimento Igreja">
    </div>
    <nav class="side-nav" aria-label="Navegação principal">
      <button class="side-link" data-nav="dashboard" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 13h8V3H3v10zm0 8h8v-6H3v6zm10 0h8V11h-8v10zm0-18v6h8V3h-8z"/></svg>
        <span>Painel</span>
      </button>
      <button class="side-link" data-nav="members" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 11c1.66 0 3-1.34 3-3s-1.34-3-3-3-3 1.34-3 3 1.34 3 3 3zm-8 0c1.66 0 3-1.34 3-3S9.66 5 8 5 5 6.34 5 8s1.34 3 3 3zm0 2c-2.33 0-7 1.17-7 3.5V19h14v-2.5c0-2.33-4.67-3.5-7-3.5zm8 0c-.29 0-.62.02-.97.05 1.16.84 1.97 1.97 1.97 3.45V19h6v-2.5c0-2.33-4.67-3.5-7-3.5z"/></svg>
        <span>Membros</span>
        <em id="nav-count" class="nav-count">0</em>
      </button>
      <button class="side-link" data-nav="birthdays" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 6c1.11 0 2-.9 2-2 0-.38-.1-.73-.29-1.03L12 0l-1.71 2.97c-.19.3-.29.65-.29 1.03 0 1.1.9 2 2 2zm4.6 9.99l-1.07-1.07-1.08 1.07c-1.3 1.3-3.58 1.31-4.89 0l-1.07-1.07-1.09 1.07C6.75 16.64 5.88 17 4.96 17c-.73 0-1.4-.23-1.96-.61V21c0 .55.45 1 1 1h16c.55 0 1-.45 1-1v-4.61c-.56.38-1.23.61-1.96.61-.92 0-1.79-.36-2.44-1.01zM18 9h-5V7h-2v2H6c-1.66 0-3 1.34-3 3v1.54c0 1.08.88 1.96 1.96 1.96.52 0 1.02-.2 1.38-.57l2.14-2.13 2.13 2.13c.74.74 2.03.74 2.77 0l2.14-2.13 2.13 2.13c.37.37.86.57 1.38.57 1.08 0 1.96-.88 1.96-1.96V12c.01-1.66-1.33-3-2.99-3z"/></svg>
        <span>Aniversariantes</span>
      </button>
      <button class="side-link" data-nav="whatsapp" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 2H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v18l4-4h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V4c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm-2 12H6v-2h12v2zm0-3H6V9h12v2zm0-3H6V6h12v2z"/></svg>
        <span>Contato</span>
      </button>
      <button class="side-link" data-nav="admins" id="nav-admins" type="button" hidden>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 1L3 5v6c0 5.55 3.84 10.74 9 12 5.16-1.26 9-6.45 9-12V5l-9-4zm0 10.99h7c-.53 4.12-3.28 7.79-7 8.94V12H5V6.3l7-3.11v8.8z"/></svg>
        <span class="lbl-long">Usuários</span><span class="lbl-short">Usuários</span>
        <em id="nav-admin-count" class="nav-count">1</em>
      </button>
    </nav>
    <div class="side-verse">
      <span class="verse-label">✝ Versículo do dia</span>
      <p id="verse-text"></p>
      <span class="side-verse-ref" id="verse-ref"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="side-user">
      <div id="user-avatar" class="avatar avatar-sm">?</div>
      <div class="side-user-info">
        <b id="user-name">—</b>
        <span id="user-role" class="role-tag">—</span>
        <span id="user-email">—</span>
      </div>
      <button id="btn-logout" class="icon-btn" type="button" title="Sair da conta" aria-label="Sair da conta">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 7l-1.41 1.41L18.17 11H8v2h10.17l-2.58 2.58L17 17l5-5-5-5zM4 5h8V3H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h8v-2H4V5z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <div class="main-col">
    <header class="topbar">
      <img class="topbar-brand" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="AMI">
      <div class="unit-switch" role="tablist" aria-label="Unidade">
        <button class="unit-btn" data-unit="all" type="button">Todas</button>
        <button class="unit-btn" data-unit="pacheco" type="button"><i class="dot dot-pacheco"></i>AMI Pacheco</button>
        <button class="unit-btn" data-unit="amendoeira" type="button"><i class="dot dot-amendoeira"></i>AMI Amendoeira</button>
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <button id="btn-new-top" class="btn btn-primary" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 13h-6v6h-2v-6H5v-2h6V5h2v6h6v2z"/></svg>
          <span>Novo membro</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div id="verse-bar" class="verse-bar" aria-live="polite">
      <svg class="verse-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 5c-1.11-.35-2.33-.5-3.5-.5-1.95 0-4.05.4-5.5 1.5-1.45-1.1-3.55-1.5-5.5-1.5S2.45 4.99 1 6v14.65c0 .25.25.5.5.5.1 0 .15-.05.25-.05C3.1 20.45 5.05 20 6.5 20c1.95 0 4.05.4 5.5 1.5 1.35-.85 3.8-1.5 5.5-1.5 1.65 0 3.35.3 4.75 1.05.1.05.15.05.25.05.25 0 .5-.25.5-.5V6c-.6-.45-1.25-.75-2-1zm0 13.5c-1.1-.35-2.3-.5-3.5-.5-1.7 0-4.15.65-5.5 1.5V8c1.35-.85 3.8-1.5 5.5-1.5 1.2 0 2.4.15 3.5.5v11.5z"/></svg>
      <div class="verse-bar-body">
        <span class="verse-bar-label">Versículo do dia</span>
        <p id="verse-bar-text" class="verse-bar-text"></p>
      </div>
      <span id="verse-bar-ref" class="verse-bar-ref"></span>
    </div>

    <main id="main" class="main">
      <section id="view-dashboard" class="view"></section>
      <section id="view-members" class="view" hidden></section>
      <section id="view-birthdays" class="view" hidden></section>
      <section id="view-whatsapp" class="view" hidden></section>
      <section id="view-admins" class="view" hidden></section>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════ DRAWER DE DETALHES ══════════ -->
<div id="drawer-overlay" class="drawer-overlay" hidden></div>
<aside id="drawer" class="drawer" hidden aria-label="Detalhes do membro"></aside>

<!-- ══════════ MODAL DE CADASTRO / EDIÇÃO ══════════ -->
<div id="form-overlay" class="modal-overlay" hidden>
  <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="form-title">
    <header class="modal-head">
      <h2 id="form-title">Novo membro</h2>
      <button id="form-close" class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Fechar">✕</button>
    </header>
    <form id="member-form" class="member-form" novalidate>
      <div class="form-scroll" id="form-scroll">
      <div class="form-grid">
        <label class="span-2">Nome completo *
          <input name="name" type="text" required maxlength="80" placeholder="Ex.: Maria Aparecida da Silva" autocomplete="off">
          <em class="field-err" data-err="name"></em>
        </label>
        <label>Unidade *
          <select name="unit" required>
            <option value="pacheco">AMI Pacheco</option>
            <option value="amendoeira">AMI Amendoeira</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>Status
          <select name="status">
            <option value="ativo">Ativo</option>
            <option value="integracao">Em integração</option>
            <option value="visitante">Visitante</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>Ministério
          <select name="ministry" id="form-ministry"></select>
        </label>
        <label>Data de nascimento
          <input name="birth" type="date">
        </label>
        <label>Telefone / WhatsApp
          <input name="phone" type="tel" placeholder="(21) 99999-9999" maxlength="20">
        </label>
        <label>E-mail
          <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="nome@email.com">
          <em class="field-err" data-err="email"></em>
        </label>
        <label>Data de entrada
          <input name="joined" type="date">
        </label>
        <label class="check-label">
          <input name="baptized" type="checkbox">
          <span class="check-box" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          Batizado(a) nas águas
        </label>
        <label class="check-label">
          <input name="peniel" type="checkbox">
          <span class="check-box" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          Fez o Peniel
        </label>
        <label class="check-label">
          <input name="wantsWork" type="checkbox">
          <span class="check-box" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          Quer trabalhar na igreja
        </label>
        <label class="span-2">Endereço / Bairro
          <input name="address" type="text" maxlength="120" placeholder="Ex.: Rua das Flores, 120 — Pacheco">
        </label>
        <label class="span-2">Observações
          <textarea name="notes" rows="3" maxlength="500" placeholder="Pedido de oração, célula, como chegou à igreja…"></textarea>
        </label>
      </div>
      </div>
      <footer class="modal-foot">
        <button id="form-cancel" class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" id="form-submit">Cadastrar membro</button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════ POPOVER SALVAR VISÃO ══════════ -->
<div id="saveview-pop" class="saveview-pop" hidden>
  <label for="saveview-name">Nome desta visão</label>
  <input id="saveview-name" type="text" maxlength="30" placeholder="Ex.: Visitantes Pacheco">
  <div class="saveview-actions">
    <button id="saveview-cancel" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" type="button">Cancelar</button>
    <button id="saveview-confirm" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button">Salvar</button>
  </div>
</div>

const $$ = s => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const uid = () => (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'id-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
const store = {
  get(k, f) { try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : f; } catch { return f; } },
  set(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch {} }
};
const storageOK = (() => {
  try { localStorage.setItem('ami.probe', '1'); const ok = localStorage.getItem('ami.probe') === '1'; localStorage.removeItem('ami.probe'); return ok; }
  catch { return false; }
})();
function setCookie(k, v, days) {
  try { document.cookie = `${k}=${encodeURIComponent(v)};path=/;max-age=${Math.round(days * 86400)};SameSite=Lax`; } catch {}
}
function getCookie(k) {
  try {
    const m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + k + '=([^;]*)'));
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
  } catch { return ''; }
}
function delCookie(k) { try { document.cookie = `${k}=;path=/;max-age=0;SameSite=Lax`; } catch {} }

function verseOfDay() {
  const day = Math.floor(today().getTime() / 86400000);
  return VERSES[((day % VERSES.length) + VERSES.length) % VERSES.length];
}
let verseKey = null;
function renderVerse(force) {
  const key = today().toDateString();
  if (!force && key === verseKey) return;
  verseKey = key;
  const v = verseOfDay();
  const put = (sel, txt) => { const el = $(sel); if (el) el.textContent = txt; };
  put('#verse-text', `“${v.t}”`);
  put('#verse-ref', v.r);
  put('#verse-bar-text', v.t);
  put('#verse-bar-ref', v.r);
  const bar = $('#verse-bar');
  if (bar) { bar.classList.remove('verse-swap'); void bar.offsetWidth; bar.classList.add('verse-swap'); }
}

function parseDate(s) {
  if (!s) return null;
  const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
  return new Date(y, m - 1, d);
}
function fmtDate(s) {
  const d = parseDate(s);
  return d ? `${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}/${d.getFullYear()}` : '—';
}
function today() { const t = new Date(); return new Date(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth(), t.getDate()); }
function nextBirthdayDays(birth) {
  const b = parseDate(birth);
  if (!b) return Infinity;
  const t = today();
  let next = new Date(t.getFullYear(), b.getMonth(), b.getDate());
  if (next < t) next = new Date(t.getFullYear() + 1, b.getMonth(), b.getDate());
  return Math.round((next - t) / 86400000);
}
function turningAge(birth) {
  const b = parseDate(birth);
  if (!b) return null;
  const t = today();
  let age = t.getFullYear() - b.getFullYear();
  if (new Date(t.getFullYear(), b.getMonth(), b.getDate()) < t) age++;
  return age;
}
function currentAge(birth) {
  const b = parseDate(birth);
  if (!b) return null;
  const t = today();
  let age = t.getFullYear() - b.getFullYear();
  if (new Date(t.getFullYear(), b.getMonth(), b.getDate()) > t) age--;
  return age;
}
function initials(name) {
  const p = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
  return ((p[0]?.[0] || '') + (p.length > 1 ? p[p.length-1][0] : '')).toUpperCase();
}
function avStyle(name) {
  let h = 0;
  for (const c of name) h = (h * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
  const [a, b] = AV_COLORS[h % AV_COLORS.length];
  return `--av-a:${a};--av-b:${b}`;
}
function avatarHTML(name, cls = '') {
  return `<div class="avatar ${cls}" style="${avStyle(name)}">${esc(initials(name))}</div>`;
}
function unitLabel(u) { return u === 'all' ? 'Todas as unidades' : UNITS[u].label; }
function unitBadge(u) { return `<span class="badge-unit badge-${u}"><i class="dot dot-${u}"></i>${UNITS[u].label}</span>`; }
function statusBadge(s) { return `<span class="badge ${STATUS[s].cls}">${STATUS[s].label}</span>`; }
function minChip(m) { const mi = MINISTRIES[m] || MINISTRIES.nenhum; return `<span class="chip-min" style="--mc:${mi.color}">${mi.label}</span>`; }
function memberFlags(m, cls = '') {

  if (m.peniel) out.push(`<span class="flag-chip peniel">${SVG_PENIEL} Peniel</span>`);
  if (m.wantsWork) out.push(`<span class="flag-chip servir">${SVG_HEART} Quer servir</span>`);
  return out.length ? `<span class="mini-flags ${cls}">${out.join('')}</span>` : '';
}

/* ═════════ Criptografia local (SHA-256 puro, sem dependências) ═════════ */
function sha256Hex(input) {
  const rr = (v, a) => (v >>> a) | (v << (32 - a));
  const K = [0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2];
  const H = [0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19];
  const utf8 = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  const bitLen = utf8.length * 8;
  const total = ((utf8.length + 1 + 8 + 63) >> 6) << 6;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(total);
  bytes.set(utf8);
  bytes[utf8.length] = 0x80;
  const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
  dv.setUint32(total - 8, Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000));
  dv.setUint32(total - 4, bitLen >>> 0);
  const w = new Uint32Array(64);
  for (let b = 0; b < total; b += 64) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = dv.getUint32(b + i * 4);
    for (let i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
      const s0 = rr(w[i-15],7) ^ rr(w[i-15],18) ^ (w[i-15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rr(w[i-2],17) ^ rr(w[i-2],19) ^ (w[i-2] >>> 10);
      w[i] = (w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) | 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b2 = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const S1 = rr(e,6) ^ rr(e,11) ^ rr(e,25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + w[i]) | 0;
      const S0 = rr(a,2) ^ rr(a,13) ^ rr(a,22);
      const maj = (a & b2) ^ (a & c) ^ (b2 & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + maj) | 0;
      h = g; g = f; f = e; e = (d + t1) | 0; d = c; c = b2; b2 = a; a = (t1 + t2) | 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) | 0; H[1] = (H[1] + b2) | 0; H[2] = (H[2] + c) | 0; H[3] = (H[3] + d) | 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) | 0; H[5] = (H[5] + f) | 0; H[6] = (H[6] + g) | 0; H[7] = (H[7] + h) | 0;
  }
  return H.map(x => (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');
}
const makeSalt = () => Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(8))).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
const hashPass = (salt, pass) => sha256Hex(`${salt}:${pass}`);
